question: Are Taaqol gamma and Saleh/Qiyas gamma the same operation on different representations, or distinct operations?

Taaqol_gamma.input_type: SlotGraph — unified composition object containing Center, TraceRef, Slots, OutputBoundary, Rank, Residuals, GenerationSource

Saleh_Qiyas_gamma.signature: gamma(candidate_type, candidate_fields, candidate_has_residuals, candidate_identity_ids, candidate_trace_ids, layer_spec, target_boundary) -> GammaResult
Saleh_Qiyas_gamma.input_type: 7 DECOMPOSED candidate properties + LayerSpec + TargetBoundary — NOT a SlotGraph

FORBIDDEN_LEAP.Taaqol: output_boundary.output_layer > declared_layer — SlotGraph output exceeds its declared layer ceiling
FORBIDDEN_LEAP.Saleh_Qiyas: candidate_type NOT in target_boundary.closes — candidate type is outside allowed boundary
FORBIDDEN_LEAP.note: Both represent a boundary violation; expressed on different domain objects

BLOCKED.Taaqol: blocking residual present (ResidualKind.BLOCKING) — constitutional residual blocks closure
BLOCKED.Saleh_Qiyas: any of: missing required fields, forbidden output type, no identity_ids, no trace_ids, identity∩trace overlap, active blockers
BLOCKED.note: Taaqol BLOCKED = specifically blocking residual; Saleh BLOCKED = general structural violation accumulation

OPEN.Taaqol: a required slot is not FILLED — graph is incomplete, more evidence needed
OPEN.Saleh_Qiyas: never directly returned — conditions map to residual_keys only

PERFORATED_CLOSED.Taaqol: all required slots filled, rank within ceiling, but visible non-blocking residuals remain
PERFORATED_CLOSED.Saleh_Qiyas: no violations, but residual_keys present (unmet conditions from LayerSpec.conditions)
PERFORATED_CLOSED.semantically_equivalent: PARTIAL — both mean 'closed with caveats' but the caveats are different objects

MINIMALLY_CLOSED.Taaqol: all required slots filled, rank within ceiling, no perforating residuals
MINIMALLY_CLOSED.Saleh_Qiyas: no violations, no residual_keys — all checks pass
MINIMALLY_CLOSED.semantically_equivalent: PARTIAL — same intent but Taaqol includes rank algebra

INVALID.Taaqol: structural construction errors: CENTER_MISSING, TRACE_MISSING, DOMAIN_MISSING, SCOPE_MISSING, IDENTITY_BROKEN, HIDDEN_RESIDUAL, RANK_EXCEEDS_CEILING
INVALID.Saleh_Qiyas: NOT PRESENT — these map to BLOCKED in Saleh/Qiyas

rank_effects.Taaqol: Carries rank from SlotGraph; enforces residual ceiling (PR-3 — step 9); returns rank in GammaResult; refuses if rank > ceiling
rank_effects.Saleh_Qiyas: NO rank parameter, NO rank check, NO rank in output — rank algebra is completely absent
rank_effects.critical_difference: Taaqol gamma enforces the rank lattice as a constitutional invariant; Saleh/Qiyas gamma has no rank concept

residual_effects.Taaqol: Full Residual objects (kind: BLOCKING/PERFORATING/HIDDEN_FORBIDDEN, visible: bool); ResidualPolicy.ceiling(); determines PERFORATED_CLOSED vs MINIMALLY_CLOSED
residual_effects.Saleh_Qiyas: String residual_keys only (e.g. 'condition_not_met:X'); no kind/visibility classification

failure_codes.Taaqol: Named FailureCode enum: CENTER_MISSING, TRACE_MISSING, DOMAIN_MISSING, SCOPE_MISSING, IDENTITY_BROKEN, OUTPUT_EXCEEDS_LAYER, HIDDEN_RESIDUAL, BLOCKING_RESIDUAL_PRESENT, REQUIRED_SLOT_EMPTY, RANK_EXCEEDS_CEILING
failure_codes.Saleh_Qiyas: None — uses plain violation strings (e.g. 'missing required fields: [...]')

branch_conditions.Taaqol_short_circuit: TRUE — step k refusal stops all subsequent steps
Saleh_Qiyas_8_checks: Final: violations? → BLOCKED; residual_keys? → PERFORATED_CLOSED; else → MINIMALLY_CLOSED
branch_conditions.Saleh_Qiyas_short_circuit: ONLY for FORBIDDEN_LEAP — remaining checks accumulate all violations

transition_authority.Taaqol: YES — gamma_result.state drives _GAMMA_REFUSAL_TO_TRANSITION mapping inside TransitionGate.decide(); gamma is the constitutional gating authority
transition_authority.Saleh_Qiyas: NO — GammaResult is returned but never consumed by any transition mechanism in production code

call_sites.Taaqol_authority: SINGLE — TransitionGate.decide() is the sole caller
call_sites.Saleh_Qiyas_production: ZERO — never called in any src/ production file

downstream_consumers.Taaqol: TransitionGate.decide() → TransitionVerdict → TaaqolJudgmentEnforcer → _scg_gate() → hokom pipeline stop/continue
downstream_consumers.Saleh_Qiyas: NONE in production — gamma() return value is consumed only by unit tests

verdict_rationale: Rank algebra: Taaqol enforces rank ceiling (PR-3); Saleh/Qiyas has no rank concept — they cannot be the same operation
Residual algebra: Taaqol uses full Residual objects (kind/visibility); Saleh/Qiyas uses string keys — incompatible types
INVALID state: Taaqol has 5 distinct INVALID failure codes; Saleh/Qiyas maps all structural problems to BLOCKED
Trace: Taaqol produces TraceEntryCandidate for TraceLedger integration; Saleh/Qiyas produces no trace output
Call sites: Taaqol gamma has constitutional authority at TransitionGate; Saleh/Qiyas gamma is NEVER called in production
Domain: Taaqol operates on SlotGraph (post-construction composition); Saleh/Qiyas operates on raw candidate fields (pre-construction validation)
Evaluation logic: Taaqol strictly short-circuits; Saleh/Qiyas accumulates all violations
what_Saleh_Qiyas_gamma_IS: CANDIDATE_PRE_CONSTRUCTION_COMPLETENESS_VALIDATOR — verifies that a candidate produced by a Saleh/Qiyas adapter satisfies its LayerSpec and TargetBoundary before a SlotGraph would be built

double_evaluation_risk.reason: Saleh/Qiyas gamma runs at candidate-field level BEFORE SlotGraph construction; Taaqol gamma runs AFTER SlotGraph construction via TransitionGate.decide(). They operate at different stages of the pipeline with no overlap if integrated correctly.

recommended_actions.action: RENAME Saleh/Qiyas gamma to remove naming ambiguity
recommended_actions.rationale: The name 'gamma' creates a false impression that it is the constitutional Gamma of Taaqol; it is not

recommended_actions.action: INTEGRATE as pre-construction validator in Saleh/Qiyas adapter chain
recommended_actions.call_site: adapter.compose() → validate_candidate_completeness(candidate_fields, layer_spec, target_boundary) → IF COMPLETE: build SlotGraph → TransitionGate.decide() → gamma(SlotGraph)
recommended_actions.rationale: Its checks (required fields, boundary type, blockers, identity/trace presence) are valuable pre-conditions for SlotGraph construction

recommended_actions.action: DO NOT replace Taaqol gamma with Saleh/Qiyas function
recommended_actions.rationale: Taaqol gamma is the constitutional authority with rank algebra, residual objects, and TraceLedger integration — none of which Saleh/Qiyas gamma provides

recommended_actions.action: GOVERNANCE DECISION: classify Saleh/Qiyas gamma as pre-construction validator with explicit scope
recommended_actions.scope: CANDIDATE_FIELD_COMPLETENESS at adapter level — NOT transition judgment

correct_integration_flow.step_1: Saleh/Qiyas adapter.compose(inputs) → builds raw candidate fields
correct_integration_flow.step_3: IF COMPLETE: construct SlotGraph from candidate
correct_integration_flow.step_4: TransitionGate.decide(slot_graph, target_layer, evidence) → calls gamma(SlotGraph) internally → TransitionVerdict
correct_integration_flow.step_5: Saleh/Qiyas adapter emits candidate or blocks on TransitionVerdict

constitutional_findings.GAMMA_CANONICAL_OWNER: TAAQOL — Taaqol gamma(SlotGraph) is the constitutional closure authority
constitutional_findings.PRODUCTION_CALL_SITES_REQUIRED: YES — Saleh/Qiyas function currently has zero production call sites
constitutional_findings.note: Classification is DISTINCT_OPERATIONS — no constitutional conflict. Integration path is clear. Rename and explicit scope required before implementation.
